input: mel (B,1,40,98) float32 log-mel - 40 mel bins x 98 frames (10 ms hop), 16 kHz
preprocessing: resample 16k -> logmel(n_fft=512, hop=160, 40 mels, center-padded) -> crop/pad to 98 frames -> transpose to (40,98)
training: Trained on positive 1200, positive_real 122, negative 3000, negative_real 694, noise 800. Block-interleaved room split, seed 42, 30 epochs MPS, best val_auc 0.9999851296692839 at epoch 20 (deployed epoch; an earlier version of train_cnn.py wrote 23 here)
onnx: opset 13, ir_version 7, single file, exported with the legacy TorchScript exporter (dynamo=False)
